tomas.texto: Every time you turn it on, it forgets how you work.
tomas.estilo: close and friendly, with a knowing half smile

tomas.texto: Which programs you were using. Which tabs you had open. Where every window went. And on which screen.
And it's on you to rebuild it. Window by window. Every single day.
tomas.estilo: sympathetic, with a touch of weariness

tomas.texto: What if your desktop had a memory?
tomas.estilo: excited, slowing down, posing a big idea

tomas.texto: You set it up once, your way: your apps, your tabs, your projects. Everything in its place.
And from then on, one click... and it all comes back. Exactly the way you saved it.
tomas.estilo: satisfied, with a suspenseful pause before and it all comes back

tomas.texto: A space for coding. Another for studying. Another for creating. And you jump between them without losing the thread.
Windows snap into their zones on their own. And if you feel like it, just ask with your voice.
Because your time is for working, not for arranging windows.
Now, at last: your computer remembers how you work.
tomas.estilo: warm and unhurried, closing with a smile
